answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. The mechanism is sound because grades are sealed and only opened at close, which stops a cluster from coordinating its votes inside a single jury. Consider a voyage as the anchor of the cost.
